span.label: mechanisms
span.term: Synaptic interactions between excitatory and inhibitory populations operating at theta and gamma timescales, coupled by a negative feedback loop, generate the two-peaked (delta-theta and gamma) spectral profile of information content.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: Short-term synaptic depression of the bottom-up pathway depletes available neurotransmitter as the speech envelope arrives, producing large onset responses and attenuated responses to later syllables.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: The beta peak in early auditory cortex is inherited top-down from higher cortical areas rather than generated locally, which is why a single-area microcircuit model cannot reproduce it.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: Excessive self-excitation drives the network into strong baseline synchronisation and saturating oscillatory responses, so different speech segments elicit near-identical patterns and stimulus information is lost.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Successful decoding does not establish that the decoded activity plays a functional role in speech processing.
span.note: what this limits: any functional claim built on the decoding: WE ACKNOWLEDGE THAT OUR DECODING RESULTS DO NOT UNAMBIGUOUSLY IMPLY A CORRESPONDING FUNCTIONAL ROLE IN SPEECH PROCESSING
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The study is correlational; establishing causal contributions would require intervention, which was not done.
span.note: what this limits: any causal reading: CAUSAL CONTRIBUTIONS ARE BEST EXPLORED WITH INTERVENTIONAL APPROACHES, WHICH ARE BEYOND THE SCOPE OF THIS WORK
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The model fails to reproduce the baseline beta power peak and its speech-induced reduction.
span.note: what this limits: the model's account of the spectral profile: A KEY FEATURE THAT OUR MODEL DOES NOT REPRODUCE IS THE PRESENCE OF A POWER PEAK IN THE BETA RANGE, WHICH IS REDUCED BY SPEECH STIMULATION
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The model does not capture the full inter-trial variability of the iEEG data.
span.note: what this limits: the model's account of trial-to-trial variability: OUR RATE MODEL ... IS NOT EXPECTED TO FULLY CAPTURE THE EXTENT AND COMPLEXITY OF THE INTER-TRIAL VARIABILITY IN THE iEEG DATASET

It passed every check we own, because the staged text said the same wrong thing: the offsets were right and text_sha1 matched. Repaired only where the character stands in an operator's place - spaced, with a number after it - because the same U+00BC is a REAL QUARTER in six other papers ('a ¼ inch condenser microphone'). span.label: Pre-stimulus intracortical activity in early auditory cortex was not scale-free: spectra carried a delta-range shoulder and a beta-range bump, and speech then cut beta power while raising delta-theta and gamma power.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Single-trial decoding of speech was better from phase than from power, and information content was bimodal across frequency — high at delta-theta and at gamma, low at the intervening beta band.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Phase's decoding advantage over power grew as the discrimination got harder, from an effect size of 0.79 for easy discrimination to 1.21 for hard discrimination.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Concatenating power and phase patterns gave no decoding gain over whichever of the two was already the more informative.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Power information about the mere presence of speech transferred between low and high frequencies but not into the alpha-beta band, whereas information about which speech segment was heard was frequency-specific.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Phase-based decoders trained at one frequency failed when tested at a sufficiently different frequency, showing that speech information sits in frequency-specific phase patterns.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The two-subnetwork rate model reproduced the iEEG spectra and decoding profile but failed on one feature: it produced no beta power reduction with speech, which every patient showed.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Trial-by-trial similarity between the model and the iEEG data was itself bimodal across frequency — high at delta-theta and gamma, low at alpha-beta — and comparable in size to the similarity between one patient and another.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Across a large family of parameter variations, recurrent excitatory connection strength in either subnetwork was the parameter that mattered most for decoding performance, with encoding degrading only at near-instability values.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: For the hardest discrimination, phase gave strongly significant decoding in 9 of 10 patients while power did so in only 4 of 10.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.
